_about: Curated, vetted third-party skills. Install ONLY on first need, after the teacher says yes (see skill-scout.md). Licenses were read from the repos on 2026-11-19; re-check before use. Entries with license NONE are guide-only.

skills.name: pptx
skills.for: Create/edit real .pptx files (our teacher-slides makes web decks, not .pptx)
skills.install: npx skills add anthropics/skills --skill pptx -a claude-code

skills.name: docx
skills.install: npx skills add anthropics/skills --skill docx -a claude-code

skills.name: xlsx
skills.install: npx skills add anthropics/skills --skill xlsx -a claude-code

skills.name: pdf
skills.for: Read, merge, split, fill, create PDFs
skills.install: npx skills add anthropics/skills --skill pdf -a claude-code

skills.name: modern-web-guidance
skills.for: Current web-platform guidance when building/fixing web pages or sites
skills.install: npx skills add GoogleChrome/modern-web-guidance -a claude-code (skill name not checked; read its SKILL.md first)

skills.name: security-audit-skill
skills.for: One-time security review before publishing a site/tool (uses many sub-agents; tell the teacher it is slow)

skills.name: kordoc
skills.for: Read HWP/HWPX, extract forms, Markdown to HWPX (3k stars, active). Candidate only: SKILL.md and scripts not yet read; vet before use. Another option on this machine may already exist (hwp-docs plugin).
skills.install: npx skills add chrisryugj/kordoc -a claude-code (skill name not verified)

guide_only.name: canine89/hwpxskill, jkf87/hwpx-skill, canine89/gonggong_hwpxskills
guide_only.reason: no license in repo (GitHub reports none) - do not install/copy; mention to teacher only

guide_only.name: NomaDamas/k-skill hwp
guide_only.reason: MIT, but its SKILL.md tells the agent to run `npx -y @nomadamas/k-skill instruct hwp` and obey the output: live remote instructions = prompt-injection-shaped, avoid
